title: How to Make Gluten-Free Sourdough Bread
description: A crackly-crusted, tangy boule raised entirely by a gluten-free starter and bound with whole psyllium husk — the bucket-list bake for anyone who loves a long-fermented loaf.
watch: Requires an active gluten-free sourdough starter (Bakerita has a starter tutorial; it takes a week or more to establish). Use maple syrup rather than honey if preferred. Flours: superfine brown rice, sorghum, potato starch, tapioca — weigh them; swaps change hydration.

title: Gluten-Free Sourdough Focaccia
description: Bubbly, olive-oil-soaked focaccia leavened with sourdough starter and studded with whatever toppings you like — a great way to use starter discard.
watch: Needs a gluten-free sourdough starter (active or fresh discard). 'Whole grain flours of choice' — she tested quinoa, sorghum and brown rice; starch can be potato, tapioca or arrowroot. Use a kitchen scale.

title: Fluffy Stovetop Gluten-Free Flatbread
description: Soft, bendy yeasted flatbreads cooked in a skillet in under an hour — tear them for dips, fold them around fillings, or use them as quick pizza bases.
watch: Use cane sugar or maple syrup (honey optional). Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products). Brown rice flour + potato starch; whole psyllium husk (use 8 g if ground).

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Bagels (Chewy and Tender!)
description: Properly boiled-then-baked bagels with a glossy, chewy crust and an everything-seasoning crown, made with no eggs or dairy at all.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters).
watch: Uses a store-bought gluten-free 1:1 flour plus extra xanthan gum; author recommends a light blend of rice flour and starches — check your blend contains no almond flour. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products). Check everything-bagel seasoning label for cross-contact.

title: Gluten-free Vegan Pumpkin Bread
description: A warmly spiced, cinnamon-heavy pumpkin loaf topped with crunchy pepitas, built on a from-scratch rice and sorghum flour mix rather than a store blend.
swaps: Recipe lists almond milk — use oat or soy milk instead (recipe allows any non-dairy milk).
watch: Uses its own flour mix (brown rice, sorghum, corn starch, tapioca + xanthan gum) — no blend label to worry about. Pumpkin seeds are fine; buy a brand without tree-nut cross-contact warnings.

title: Gluten Free Bagels
description: Soft, deeply chewy bagels designed from the start to be egg-free, using a psyllium and chia-bound whole-grain flour mix and a maple-sweetened water bath.
swaps: Use maple syrup (not honey) if you want them vegan; otherwise safe as written.
watch: Uses its own blend (brown rice, sorghum, millet, tapioca, psyllium husk powder). Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Bread (Buckwheat & Psyllium)
description: A hearty, yeast-free sandwich loaf with a crisp crust and moist crumb, held together by psyllium gel and flavored with buckwheat and chickpea flours.
watch: Flours: buckwheat, white rice, chickpea, tapioca — buy certified gluten-free buckwheat. Psyllium husk powder (the gel sets fast). Pumpkin seeds optional.

title: Vegan Gluten Free Bread
description: A yeasted, egg-free sandwich loaf using a buckwheat and brown rice base with psyllium for a sliceable, toastable crumb — no gums, no store-bought blend.
watch: Whole or ground psyllium husk (not Metamucil-type supplements). Buckwheat flour should be certified GF. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Easy Gluten-Free Flour Tortillas
description: Soft, foldable flour-style tortillas that actually roll without cracking thanks to a psyllium gel — taco night and burritos are back on.
watch: Tested with King Arthur Measure for Measure gluten-free flour plus extra tapioca; blend matters. Video on page helps with rolling.

title: Gluten Free Pizza Crust
description: A chewy, foldable yeasted pizza base with a psyllium boost that bakes up crisp at the edges — written by an allergy mom for top-allergen-free households.
swaps: Top with nut-free dairy-free cheese (check label — many vegan cheeses are cashew-based).
watch: Tested with King Arthur Measure for Measure gluten-free flour; blend matters. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Gluten-free Vegan Double Chocolate Muffins
description: Deep-cocoa, applesauce-moist muffins dotted with chocolate chips — a fast breakfast-treat that is top-8 free by design.
swaps: Use maple syrup or agave (not honey) to keep vegan; any safe milk can replace rice milk.
watch: Uses Ener-G egg replacer and coconut oil (coconut — flag). Author recommends her own GF flour blend; a nut-free 1:1 blend with xanthan also works. Use dairy-free, nut-free chocolate chips (e.g., Enjoy Life).

title: Vegan Gluten-Free Potato Buns
description: Pillowy golden buns made tender with mashed potato — sized for burgers and sandwiches, and gum-free thanks to psyllium.
swaps: Use a nut-free non-dairy milk such as oat (certified GF) or soy.
watch: Uses a simple homemade blend (brown + white rice flour, tapioca). Coconut sugar (sweetener, not coconut meat — flag for caution). Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Oil-Free Cinnamon Rolls (Vegan + GF)
description: Yeast-free swirls built on sweet potato and date paste, with a whipped coconut-milk frosting — a fruit-sweetened take on Sunday cinnamon rolls.
watch: Tested with King Arthur gluten-free all-purpose blend (author says Bob's 1-to-1 also works) plus tapioca flour. Frosting is full-fat coconut milk and dough uses coconut sugar — coconut flag.

title: Vegan Gluten Free Banana Bread
description: A classic, deeply caramelized banana loaf with cinnamon and nutmeg, bound with a flax egg and finished with a crackly sugar top.
swaps: Omit the walnuts (in the batter and on top) — swap in pumpkin seeds or dairy-free chocolate chips if you want crunch.
watch: Uses a store-bought gluten-free all-purpose flour (272 g) — choose a nut-free 1:1 blend with xanthan gum. Coconut oil (flag); soy milk is fine.

title: Buckwheat Cinnamon Raisin Bagels
description: Earthy, cinnamon-scented bagels ground from whole buckwheat groats and studded with raisins — fantastic toasted with jam.
watch: You grind buckwheat groats yourself (buy certified gluten-free groats). Coconut oil (flag). Flax + psyllium bind the dough. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Gluten-Free Crusty Seeded Rolls (Vegan)
description: Rustic, crackly rolls packed with pumpkin, sunflower and sesame seeds — the kind of bread you tear open next to a bowl of soup.
watch: Brown rice flour + arrowroot, bound with ground flax and chia. Buy seeds without tree-nut cross-contact warnings. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Vegan Cornbread (gluten-free)
description: Tender, lightly sweet cornbread made with oat flour and a vegan 'buttermilk' — a thoroughly tested, egg-free side for chili and holiday tables.
swaps: Use a nut-free non-dairy milk such as oat (certified GF) or soy.
watch: Oat flour MUST be certified gluten-free; cornmeal should be labeled GF. Coconut oil (flag).

title: Eggless Banana Muffins
description: Tall, cinnamon-spiced banana muffins loaded with chocolate chips, designed egg-free from the start.
swaps: Use a 1:1 gluten-free flour (author tested King Arthur Measure for Measure and Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1; use 310 g if Bob's). Use a nut-free non-dairy milk such as oat (certified GF) or soy. Use dairy-free chocolate chips.
watch: Blend matters — other GF brands untested. Let GF version cool almost completely or it will be gummy.

title: Gluten Free Rolls Without Xanthan Gum
description: Soft, high-rising dinner rolls with no eggs and no gums — ready in about an hour, which makes them a realistic weeknight or holiday add-on.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters). (for brushing only)
watch: Uses Zest for Baking's homemade rice-and-starch flour blend; author says other blends are untested. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Gluten Free Apple Bread (Dairy Free)
description: A yeasted pull-apart-style loaf layered with tart apples, brown sugar and cinnamon — a fall showpiece for brunch.
swaps: Recipe uses almond milk — swap oat or soy milk. Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters).
watch: Uses Zest for Baking's homemade rice-and-starch flour blend (other blends untested). Coconut oil in dough (flag). Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Gluten-Free English Muffins
description: Griddle-cooked English muffins with real nooks and crannies, bound with ground chia instead of egg — split, toast, and pile on toppings.
watch: Oat flour MUST be certified gluten-free. Brown rice flour, tapioca and potato starch (not potato flour). Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Easy Gluten Free Biscuits (Vegan & Dairy-Free)
description: Flaky, buttery biscuits speckled with scallions and brushed with a maple glaze — savory-sweet and quick enough for a weeknight.
swaps: Use a nut-free non-dairy milk such as oat (certified GF) or soy. Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters).
watch: Tested with Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1 Gluten Free Baking Flour; blend matters.

title: Multiseed Homemade Healthy Crackers
description: Crisp, flour-free seed crackers made from flax, chia, sunflower and pumpkin seeds — snappy for hummus, sturdy enough for a party board.
watch: Buy seeds without tree-nut cross-contact warnings. Optional nutritional yeast is fine (not the same as brewer's yeast — check the label says gluten-free).

title: Vegan Blueberry Muffins (Gluten-Free, Nut-Free)
description: Bakery-style blueberry muffins made with whole-grain oat flour and aquafaba, bursting with fresh berries and labeled nut-free by the author.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters).
watch: Oat flour MUST be certified gluten-free; oat milk too. Coconut sugar (flag).

title: Old-Fashioned Gluten-Free + Vegan Buttermilk Biscuits
description: Southern-style, pull-apart biscuits with a tangy dairy-free 'buttermilk' — six ingredients and on the table in under 20 minutes.
swaps: Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters). (for brushing)
watch: Coconut milk is the 'buttermilk' base (coconut flag — soy milk + vinegar is a common swap but untested). Gluten-free baking flour + sorghum flour; use a nut-free 1:1 blend.

title: Easy Gluten-Free Naan
description: Four-ingredient, yeast-leavened naan cooked on a hot griddle until blistered — brush with garlic oil and serve with curry.
swaps: If brushing with vegan butter: Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters).
watch: Uses a plain gluten-free all-purpose flour (choose a nut-free blend with gum). Optional yogurt must be nut-free (coconut or soy). Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: Easy Gluten Free & Vegan Soft Pretzel Bites
description: Chewy, salty pretzel bites given a baking-soda bath for that deep brown crust — perfect game-day snacking with mustard.
watch: Tested with Bob's Red Mill Gluten Free 1-to-1 Baking Flour; blend matters. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products). Check mustard/dip labels.

title: Vegan Gluten Free Cinnamon Rolls
description: Squishy, yeasted cinnamon scrolls made with rice and glutinous rice flours and psyllium — no eggs, gums or nuts — finished with vanilla icing.
swaps: Use soy or oat milk (author used soy). Use a nut-free vegan butter (e.g., Earth Balance or Melt — check label; avoid Miyoko's and other cashew/almond-based butters).
watch: Needs fine white rice flour and glutinous (sweet) rice flour, which is gluten-free despite the name. Use gluten-free baking powder. Use plain dry/instant yeast labeled gluten-free (avoid brewer's yeast and malted products).

title: 8-Ingredient Coconut Cranberry Scones
description: Tender, lightly sweet scones with tart dried cranberries and a crunchy sugar top, made with a flax egg and coconut oil.
watch: Coconut oil and coconut milk (flag). Author used Bob's Red Mill All-Purpose Baking Flour (a bean-based blend, not the 1-to-1); results will differ with other blends. Check the dried cranberry label for cross-contact.

title: Vegan Zucchini Bread
description: A moist, cinnamon-spiced zucchini loaf with a lemon drizzle, made with a flax egg and no milk at all.
swaps: Use a gluten-free flour mix (author's GF variation; commenters used Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1).
watch: Author advises avoiding GF blends with garbanzo bean or sorghum flour here. Pick a nut-free blend that includes xanthan gum.
